help: Node size ~ square root of scene count, edge width ~ shared scenes (or productions, see "Count edge strength by"). Click a performer to highlight their network, double-click to open their page. Ctrl/Cmd-click two performers for the shortest path. Esc or a click on the background resets. On a touch screen: "Path from here" in a performer's details, then tap the second one.

faceWriteFailed: could not store face positions on performers:
setStoreFacesHelp: Saves the detected face box (four numbers, image checksum, detector version) in the performer custom field spn_face so other devices skip detection. Off by default. Stash then also updates the performer's updated_at (once per performer, and again when its image changes).
setUseCropsHelp: Off: nodes show the performer image cropped to a square as set under "Crop without a face"; MediaPipe is not loaded and nothing is stored.
setFallbackCropHelp: Which square of the image is shown when no face is found (or face crops are off). Automatic: from the top for tall images (more than 1.5 times as high as wide, such as full-body photos), else the upper third.
setRedetectAllConfirm: Detect all {count} faces again? With storing switched on this updates every performer (and its updated_at).
setRedetectStarted: Detection started; faces are replaced as they are done.
setLabelZoomHelp: Names are drawn once they are at least this many pixels high on screen, so zooming in shows more of them; 0 = always.
setStartLimit: Large networks start with at most this many performers
setStartLimitHelp: Larger networks first show the favorites and their strongest partners (without favorites: the most connected performers); "Show all" in the status line or ?all=1 shows everyone. 50 to 10,000, default 400.
setDefaultsHint: Defaults apply when the page is opened; URL parameters (e.g. ?count=productions&studio=3) override them for that view.
setStashHint: Stored in Stash's plugin settings: the same on every device, also under Settings → Plugins.
setStoreFacesExisting: Performers in this library already have stored face data, so storing stays on until you save this setting (new installations start with it off).
